text: NASA built a robot to last ninety days. It lasted fifteen years.
In twenty-eighteen, a dust storm blocked out the sun, and it went quiet.
Its last signal, loosely translated: my battery is low, and it's getting dark.
For eight months, NASA called it more than a thousand times.
Then they played it one last song. I'll Be Seeing You.
No one should go dark alone.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny always answers.
Search Feeloy on the App Store.
